name: audit-loose-ends
description: ✍️ Reconciles your durable records at the end of a task or session — memories, project notes, reminders, task lists and, if installed, the waypoints store — so finished work is never left flagged as to-do and nothing redundant or orphaned stays behind. A transcript scanner audits long sessions cheaply, a check confirms git hygiene and test results, and a secret scanner sweeps touched files.
